steps.speaker: Dudu
steps.content: All right, now we start the Drifter Camp tour! The guide fee is only 30,000, and you can get a song, Drifter Camp Friendship, for an extra 5,000!
You have nothing to say about her ridiculous pricing. Whatever. Nightingale will take care of it.

steps.speaker: K.K.
steps.content: Hey, don't keep raising the price. My commission fee for tour guiding is only 600 DisCoins. You're asking for too much.

steps.speaker: Dudu
steps.content: Don't worry about it. You're not paying. Forget about your hard-working personality today, and enjoy the pleasure of being a consumer!

steps.speaker: Dudu
steps.content: The elevator is about to reach the upper level, so get ready for... Drifter Camp!
The elevator door opens, and a lively scene you never expected is presented in front of you.
There are cluttered but eye-catching homemade billboards, the indescribable taste of sweet and sour mixed with bitterness, and various sounds like a wonderful symphony...
You never imagined that the interior of this huge slum was so lively, let alone that the capes who attacked you only a short time ago lived here.

steps.speaker: Dudu
steps.content: Stunned? Hmph, this is only the surface of Drifter Camp. Don't touch anything. There will be trouble if you accidentally trigger any mechanism!

steps.speaker: Dudu
steps.content: That's right! DisCity looks down on Syndicate, and Syndicate looks down on Drifter Camp. But just look on both sides of the Rust, where else can you find a cooler castle?

steps.speaker: Dudu
steps.content: Behold!
She pulls a lever, and with a few clanks, a small railcar rolls over to you, hanging on the rail. Dudu pushes you into the car, and with another pull, the railcar keeps moving forward.
In the car, you feel a pair of eyes fixed on you. It's K.K.

steps.speaker: K.K.
steps.content: Um... I heard suspended animation takes a huge toll on your body, and the adjutant said that you have been in bad shape lately. So how are you feeling? Anything wrong?

steps.speaker: K.K.
steps.content: Please tell me. It's... part of the commission.

options: It hurts. Mommy, make it better.

steps.content: You do feel a little rough, but it's nothing compared to what you've suffered before, and there's no time to waste. You nod to K.K. with a confident smile.
K.K. winces like you've triggered some horrible memory. She turns away and ignores you.
The car stops, the door opens automatically, and Dudu jumps down excitedly.

steps.speaker: Dudu
steps.content: Here we are!

steps.speaker: Dudu
steps.content: Central Plaza! Grand Stall!

options: ...Why are we in the most crowded place?

steps.speaker: Dudu
steps.content: Why? Are you scared that people will notice you? Or are you still thinking about work?

steps.speaker: Dudu
steps.content: Wake up! Look at you and the dark circles under your eyes! Do you not realize how horrible you look? You can't work like that.

steps.speaker: Dudu
steps.content: It's mealtime already! Can you really resist? Can you smell it? The sweet and sour taste, the sizzling oil, and the laughter of the diners who are chowing down gourmets...

steps.speaker: Dudu
steps.content: Besides, this is the most lively and best place to get info, and anything unsettling will spread immediately. You can just fill your stomach here!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Ahhhhh, I can't do this anymore! I want some too! There's nothing under there. I'm hungry and I want some good food!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: ${PlayerName} went up with just a cloak. Why do I have to chew on bland buns down here?!

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: The agent said that some people had already remembered our faces. Following Chief would cause trouble.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: There are two locals, Dudu and K.K., so they won't look too suspicious. But if we all went up together, three strangers would arouse suspicions.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: But I want delicious food!

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Be quiet. You'll attract unwanted attention. Here, have a bun.
With that, Hella's whimpering sound comes from the other end of the communication, as if something is being stuffed in her mouth.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: K.K., protect Chief. I can't stay by his side right now, and I would be upset if anything happened.
steps.female_content: K.K., protect Chief. I can't stay by her side right now, and I would be upset if anything happened.

steps.speaker: K.K.
steps.content: Okay... If this is a part of the commission as well.
As you're talking, a tall man suddenly wraps his arms around K.K.'s neck. You are taken aback.

steps.speaker: Tally
steps.content: Hey... Isn't this Whitestone's K.K.? Good to finally have one of you back... I heard an Outland bigwig is going to invest in you. Is that true?

steps.speaker: Tally
steps.content: ...So can you pay back the meat money you owe me?

steps.speaker: Tally
steps.content: Every time you guys have a hotpot, that scoundrel Bai Yi takes some meat from me and leaves an IOU. I have enough IOUs to make a book.

steps.speaker: Greta
steps.content: Your boss had too much to drink and made a scene in my clinic. She spilled a lot of drugs, and those were worth a lot...

steps.speaker: Greta
steps.content: And the one with blonde hair got me writing notes so he could pretend to be sick...
A granny suddenly grabs the corner of K.K.'s coat, and the crowd instantly falls silent.

steps.speaker: K.K.
steps.content: Auntie Margaret... What brings you here?

steps.speaker: Margaret
steps.content: ...You're finally back?

steps.speaker: Margaret
steps.content: Who are you?

steps.speaker: test
steps.content: It's K.K. I'm back.

steps.speaker: Dudu
steps.content: Oh, that granny has Alzheimer's. Everyone pretty much loves her.

steps.speaker: Margaret
steps.content: K.K.? K.K.

steps.speaker: K.K.
steps.content: Yeah, K.K.

steps.speaker: Margaret
steps.content: Pay back.
People burst into laughter and swarm her again.

steps.speaker: Dudu
steps.content: Go ahead. I'm too busy eating.
